category.name: Office suite and files
category.description: Business document editing, office collaboration and file sync/share; distinguish integrated hubs from file platforms and editor components.
category.audience: Business teams across functions creating, storing and collaborating on documents.
category.audienceRationale: Documents, spreadsheets and shared files recur across most office-based businesses; broad suite and storage incumbents address small teams through enterprises. This is qualitative reach, not a measured market-size ranking.

pricing.note: Business Starter standard USD $7/user/month with one-year commitment; temporary promotions excluded.
Business Basic without Teams USD $5.40/user/month paid yearly; web/mobile apps. Basic with Teams $7; desktop apps require another plan.
Business Standard displayed $15/user/month; billing selector state not reliably preserved by extraction, so no normalized entry amount claimed. Personal Plus $9.99 also shown.

oss.name: Collabora Online
oss.classificationReason: Source and functionality remain open; commercial offering sells stable supported builds. CODE rolling builds lack SLA/LTS and are not recommended by vendor for production. September 2026 maintainer confirms default CODE has no document/connection caps; optional home mode introduces 20-connection/10-document limits. Source is now in Gerrit; GitHub source mirror used for health, not old issue-only repository.

alternatives.migrationNotes: Broad collaboration hub: file sync/share, groupware, calls and document collaboration via apps. Configure an office engine and existing email server/provider; not a replacement for all proprietary desktop features, advanced formulas/macros, tenant identity or compliance services. Export native cloud document formats to portable Office/ODF files and pilot fidelity before migrating.

Editor component for documents/spreadsheets/slides, requiring external file storage/authentication such as Nextcloud, ownCloud or Seafile. Does not supply the full email/calendar/meetings/storage suite; test Office-format, macro and layout fidelity. CODE rolling builds carry production stability caveat.

Office editing component, typically integrated with sync/share storage. Not the complete mail/calendar/file suite; Docs Community has 20-editing-connection ceiling and no mobile browser editing. Export native Google documents first; test complex Office documents and integrations.

Replaces Drive/OneDrive-style file sync/share portion only; Office editing requires an external editor integration. Email, meetings and full suite absent; full-text file search and fine-grained permissions are paid Professional features.

Replaces Drive/OneDrive file sync/share portion with team spaces and WebDAV APIs; Office editors integrated separately. Mail/calendar/meetings and proprietary tenant services require other products. Choose source or vendor build after checking relevant distribution terms.
